## Substantial differences

- **Revision and effective date changed:**  
  - Version A: **Rev 9**, effective **5 October 1998**.  
  - Version B: **Rev 10**, effective **12 September 2001**.

- **New temperature-control requirement before letdown:** Version B adds a mandatory step after dispersion:  
  > “Cool batch below 40 °C before letdown. Record temperature on batch sheet.”

  This introduces:
  - A maximum temperature condition (**below 40 °C**) before adding white spirit.
  - A new documentation obligation to record the temperature.
  - An additional process-control responsibility for production personnel.

- **The process sequence is otherwise unchanged:** All quantities, materials, equipment, agitation and dispersion parameters, seasonal bentonite dose, resting time, filtration, and filling instructions remain the same.

- **Change note updated:**  
  - Version A: “Added winter dose of bentonite (CR-1998-004).”  
  - Version B: “Added cooling below 40 °C before letdown (CR-2001-012).”

## Additions in B

- New step 7:  
  > “Cool batch below 40 °C before letdown. Record temperature on batch sheet.”

- Corresponding renumbering of the subsequent steps:
  - Letdown becomes step 8.
  - Drier and MEKO addition becomes step 9.
  - Holding-tank rest becomes step 10.
  - Filtration and filling become step 11.

- New revision metadata:
  > “Revision: Rev 10, effective 12/09/2001.”

## Removals relative to A

- No substantive production step, ingredient, quantity, parameter, or final processing requirement was removed.
- The former numbering of steps 7–10 was replaced by the new numbering in Version B.
- Version A’s change note concerning the winter bentonite dose is no longer the current change note and is replaced by the 2001 cooling-related note.

## Reformulations

- The wording and formatting of the recipe steps are substantially unchanged.
- The line break and layout of step 1 and step 5 differ slightly, without changing their meaning.
- The document remains marked:
  > “[stamp] SUPERSEDED ARCHIVE COPY”

The documents are **not fully equivalent in substance**: Version B adds a mandatory cooling and temperature-recording requirement before letdown.
